hp_max.description: The absolute limit of biological damage the entity can sustain before death.

hp_regen.description: Flat HP recovered per tick during rest or passive regeneration.

stamina.description: The energy pool available for physical actions and sustained exertion.

stamina_regen.description: Stamina recovered per tick during rest or passive recovery.

water_retention.description: Hydration pool. Depleted by extreme heat and exertion; death results at zero.

mana.description: The magical energy pool available for casting skills and abilities.

carry_weight.description: Maximum load the entity can carry before being encumbered.

melee_power.description: Base physical strike force applied to melee damage calculations.

speed.description: Base movement speed in grid units per action.

ac.description: Total defensive rating determining how difficult the entity is to hit.

evasion.description: Passive dodge capability reflecting the entity's agility and reflexes.

acrobatics_bonus.description: Agility-derived bonus to balance, tumbling, and unstable footing checks.

perception.description: Passive awareness score used for detecting hidden threats and environmental cues.

stealth.description: Passive ability to avoid detection, penalized by larger body size.

vision_range.description: Base visual detection distance in grid units. Further modulated by vision type.

hearing_range.description: Base auditory detection distance in grid units. Further modulated by hearing type.

scent_range.description: Base olfactory detection distance in grid units. Further modulated by scent type.

diceMod.description: Global modifier to all dice rolls, derived from charisma (luck and destiny). Neutral at cha=10.

effectChance.description: Modifier to the probability of applying status effects on others. Driven by force of personality.

xp_value.description: Experience points granted on defeat. Always proportional to challenge rating.

loot_quality.description: Modifier for loot drop quality. Scales with challenge rating; floors at 1.0.

bludgeoning_resist.description: Mitigation against blunt-force impact. Dense muscle mass and armor absorb concussive force.

piercing_resist.description: Mitigation against puncture and penetration damage. Armor layers are less effective vs. focused tips.

slashing_resist.description: Mitigation against cutting and laceration damage. Scales and hide deflect blades effectively.

shredding_resist.description: Mitigation against tearing and flaying damage. Lowest armor benefit; requires even surface coverage.

poison_resist.description: Mitigation against toxin effects. Constitution governs the immune system's ability to neutralize venom.

disease_resist.description: Mitigation against pathogen-based infection. Reflects the robustness of the entity's immune response.

acid_resist.description: Mitigation against corrosive damage. Biological hardiness and integument density determine resilience.

fire_resist.description: Mitigation against heat and flame. Baseline thermal tolerance derived from constitution.

cold_resist.description: Mitigation against freezing damage. Baseline cold tolerance derived from constitution.

hydraulic_resist.description: Mitigation against high-pressure fluid damage. Body mass provides structural resistance to crushing water pressure.

sonic_resist.description: Mitigation against concussive sound-wave damage. Dense body mass absorbs shockwaves.

lightning_resist.description: Mitigation against electrical damage. Tissue conductivity and resilience determined by constitution.

arcane_resist.description: Mitigation against magical interference. Magical intuition and intellect provide a ward.

psychic_resist.description: Mitigation against mental intrusion. Willpower is the primary defense; intelligence reinforces the mind.

radiant_resist.description: Mitigation against divine energy damage. Spiritual fortitude derived from wisdom.

necrotic_resist.description: Mitigation against life-drain and death energy. Physical vitality and spiritual resilience both contribute.
